Drawn in code (no image source): stadium crowd tiers, LED ribbons, floodlights, spotlight beams, fireworks, dirt track faces, wooden ramp decks and steel trusses, the Death Loop ring, fire-pit glow, HUD panels.

Rider poses are transforms of the hero art split into worm and bike layers. They are not hand-drawn animation frames.
